meta.era: No Man's Sky Wiki on Miraheze. Mineral ratios from Waypoint and Endurance item articles. Craft ratios checked through Worlds Part II.
meta.disclaimer: Charging a technology is fuel. It is not a refiner recipe and it is not a craft row. Wiring loom is bought, not crafted, so it has no edge. A later patch can change a recipe. Three-input large-refiner rows are left out.
meta.omitted: Large refiner recipes with three inputs, including high-speed sublimation and plasma pressurisation. Wiring loom. Portable refiner and starship launch fuel. Silver, gold, and platinum. Cooking.

nodes.name: Ferrite Dust
nodes.blurb: Common rock mineral. The bottom of the ferrite ladder.

nodes.name: Pure Ferrite
nodes.blurb: Refined ferrite. Dust steps up one-for-one. Magnetised ferrite breaks back into two.

nodes.name: Magnetised Ferrite
nodes.blurb: Top of the portable ferrite line. Carbon or a stellar metal pushes dust and pure ferrite here faster.

nodes.name: Rusted Metal
nodes.blurb: Junk from damaged containers. One unit breaks into two ferrite dust. Oxygen rusts ferrite back into it.

nodes.name: Carbon
nodes.blurb: Mined from plants, or burnt from oxygen at a loss. Two units condense into one.

nodes.name: Condensed Carbon
nodes.blurb: Denser carbon. One unit releases two carbon. Oxygen multiplies a stack.

nodes.name: Sodium
nodes.blurb: Yellow crystals. Two make one sodium nitrate. Oxygen and carbon also catalyse it.

nodes.name: Sodium Nitrate
nodes.blurb: The charged form of sodium. One unit frees two sodium. Oxygen doubles a stack, one for one.

nodes.name: Oxygen
nodes.blurb: Kept because the mineral loops use it. Burning it for carbon is a refiner recipe, not the same as charging life support.

nodes.name: Cobalt
nodes.blurb: Cave mineral. Two ionise into one. Oxygen is the multiplier.

nodes.name: Ionised Cobalt
nodes.blurb: Charged cobalt. One unit returns two cobalt. With oxygen, one becomes six.

nodes.name: Copper
nodes.blurb: Yellow-star stellar metal. Two units make one chromatic metal.

nodes.name: Cadmium
nodes.blurb: Red-star stellar metal. Two units make one chromatic metal. Ferrite fusion pays two.

nodes.name: Emeril
nodes.blurb: Green-star stellar metal. Two units make three chromatic metal.

nodes.name: Indium
nodes.blurb: Blue-star stellar metal. Two units make four chromatic metal.

nodes.name: Chromatic Metal
nodes.blurb: The alloy the stellar metals refine into. One unit plus one stellar metal returns two of that metal.

nodes.name: Paraffinium
nodes.blurb: Lush-world mineral. In this set it feeds ferrite dust, and star bulb trades with it.

nodes.name: Salt
nodes.blurb: Aquatic mineral. Two units concentrate into chlorine. Di-hydrogen and oxygen can form it.

nodes.name: Chlorine
nodes.blurb: Concentrated salt. One unit frees two salt. Oxygen multiplies a stack, the way it does for cobalt.

nodes.name: Di-hydrogen
nodes.blurb: Blue crystals. Forty craft a jelly. A refiner condenses thirty, then breaks that jelly back into forty.

nodes.name: Di-hydrogen Jelly
nodes.blurb: Condensed di-hydrogen. The blueprint takes forty. The refiner condenses thirty, and cycling returns forty.

nodes.name: Tritium
nodes.blurb: Asteroid fuel. Five units refine into one di-hydrogen. In this set it does not make platinum.

nodes.name: Nitrogen
nodes.blurb: Lush-world atmosphere. Three units transfer into one sulphurine. Oxygen or chromatic metal moves it one for one.

nodes.name: Sulphurine
nodes.blurb: Hot-world atmosphere. It sits between nitrogen and radon in the gas transfer cycle.

nodes.name: Radon
nodes.blurb: Frozen and radioactive atmospheres. Three units transfer into one nitrogen, closing the gas cycle.

nodes.name: Metal Plating
nodes.blurb: The first crafted sheet. Fifty ferrite dust. It goes into the portable refiner and launch fuel.

nodes.name: Hermetic Seal
nodes.blurb: A carbon seal. Thirty condensed carbon. Early ship repairs ask for it.

nodes.name: Carbon Nanotubes
nodes.blurb: Fifty carbon, drawn into a conductor. The microprocessor takes one.

nodes.name: Microprocessor
nodes.blurb: Forty chromatic metal and one nanotube bundle. A landing pad later asks for two.

nodes.name: Antimatter Housing
nodes.blurb: The casing for a warp cell. Thirty oxygen and fifty ferrite dust.

nodes.name: Antimatter
nodes.blurb: Twenty-five chromatic metal and twenty condensed carbon. Pair it with a housing.

nodes.name: Ion Battery
nodes.blurb: Five ferrite dust and ten cobalt. Charges hazard protection. The three-input refiner row is left out.

nodes.name: Life Support Gel
nodes.blurb: One di-hydrogen jelly and twenty carbon. A full life-support charge. Not the same as feeding oxygen into the suit.

nodes.name: Warp Cell
nodes.blurb: One antimatter housing and one antimatter. One cell, one jump. The large-refiner bypass is left out.

nodes.name: Cactus Flesh
nodes.blurb: Desert crop. One unit burns into two carbon. The pyrite growth loop is outside this set.

nodes.name: Fungal Mould
nodes.blurb: Toxic-biome crop. One unit burns into two carbon.

nodes.name: Gamma Root
nodes.blurb: Irradiated crop. One unit burns into two carbon. Harvest wants a haz-mat gauntlet.

nodes.name: Solanium
nodes.blurb: Scorched crop, from solar vine. One unit burns into two carbon.

nodes.name: Star Bulb
nodes.blurb: Lush crop. It burns to carbon, and it trades with paraffinium.

nodes.name: Frost Crystal
nodes.blurb: Frozen crop, from frostwort. Forty polish into glass. It does not burn to carbon.

nodes.name: Kelp Sac
nodes.blurb: Water plant. Salt and nitrogen encourage one. With oxygen it yields bonded chlorine.

nodes.name: Faecium
nodes.blurb: Creature drop. The old name is Coprite. It feeds lubricant, and it swaps with mordite.

nodes.name: Mordite
nodes.blurb: Harvested from creatures and from mordite root. Three faecium reassemble into two.

nodes.name: Dioxite
nodes.blurb: Frozen-world earth. Frost crystal and salt titrate into it. It grows frost crystal back.

nodes.name: Phosphorus
nodes.blurb: Scorched-world earth. Solanium and salt titrate into it.

nodes.name: Uranium
nodes.blurb: Irradiated-world earth. Gamma root and salt titrate into it.

nodes.name: Ammonia
nodes.blurb: Toxic-world earth. Fungal mould and salt titrate into it.

nodes.name: Pyrite
nodes.blurb: Desert earth. Cactus flesh and salt titrate into it.

nodes.name: Silicate Powder
nodes.blurb: Dust from the terrain manipulator. Forty forge into one glass.

nodes.name: Glass
nodes.blurb: Forty frost crystal, from the blueprint or the refiner. Silicate powder forges it too.

nodes.name: Lubricant
nodes.blurb: Fifty faecium and four hundred gamma root. Living glass takes one.

nodes.name: Heat Capacitor
nodes.blurb: One hundred frost crystal and two hundred solanium. Half of a circuit board.

nodes.name: Poly Fibre
nodes.blurb: One hundred cactus flesh and two hundred star bulb. The other half of a circuit board.

nodes.name: Circuit Board
nodes.blurb: One heat capacitor and one poly fibre. Wiring loom is not in this recipe.

nodes.name: Living Glass
nodes.blurb: One lubricant and five glass.

nodes.name: Nitrogen Salt
nodes.blurb: Two hundred and fifty nitrogen and fifty condensed carbon. The three-input refiner row is left out.

nodes.name: Enriched Carbon
nodes.blurb: Two hundred and fifty radon and fifty condensed carbon.

nodes.name: Thermic Condensate
nodes.blurb: Two hundred and fifty sulphurine and fifty condensed carbon.

nodes.name: Unstable Plasma
nodes.blurb: Fifty oxygen and one metal plating. Launcher fuel. Charging the launcher is not a separate recipe here.
